mapper.insert: insert into tlias.student( name, no, gender, phone, id_card, is_college, address, degree, graduation_date, clazz_id, violation_count, violation_score, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{name}, #{no}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{isCollege}, #{address}, #{degree}, #{graduationDate}, #{clazzId}, #{violationCount}, #{violationScore}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: select s.*, c.name as clazz_name from tlias.student s left join tlias.clazz c on s.clazz_id = c.id where s.id = #{id}
select c.name as clazzName, count(s.id) as studentCount from tlias.clazz c left join tlias.student s on c.id = s.clazz_id group by c.id, c.name order by c.id

select case degree when 1 then '初中' when 2 then '高中' when 3 then '大专' when 4 then '本科' when 5 then '硕士' when 6 then '博士' else '未知' end as name, count(*) as value from tlias.student group by degree order by degree
